candidates.verdict: GAP (narrow) -- but borderline-trivial; generic version COLLIDES
candidates.colliding_work_or_absence: ABSENCE of the exact narrow steelman: across 5 fresh reformulations I could NOT find a single published method that prescribes, as a DESIGNED curriculum, a deliberately-HELD undifferentiated/structureless MIDDLE stage between an explicit dissolution stage and an explicit reconstitution stage. Closest neighbors: (a) Tracing Representation Geometry (arXiv 2509.23024) documents a naturally-occurring collapse->entropy-seek->compress three-phase geometry, but it is OBSERVED, not an induced method; (b) forget-and-relearn / Fortuitous Forgetting (2202.00155) does forget-then-relearn but with NO deliberately-held middle phase; (c) Leveraging chaotic transients (2506.08523) and Edge-of-chaos (2107.09437) exploit/maintain a structureless regime but not as a 3-stage dissolve-hold-reconstitute task curriculum; (d) Shrink-and-Perturb (2306.13812) does shrink+noise but in a single operation, no held liminal dwell. So the LITERAL narrow version is genuinely absent.
candidates.reasoning: This is the ONE candidate where the narrow steelman has a real residual absence: nobody published a designed 'dissolve -> deliberately HOLD in an undifferentiated liminal state -> reconstitute' 3-stage curriculum. HOWEVER I judge narrow_version_nontrivial = FALSE for three reasons. (1) The distinguishing feature -- the HELD middle stage -- is an arbitrary over-specification: forget-and-relearn already gets the dissolve+reconstitute benefit, and there is no published evidence (and no obvious mechanism) that deliberately DWELLING in the undifferentiated state longer than the momentary perturbation adds value; if anything, edge-of-chaos work suggests you want to pass THROUGH criticality, not park in it. (2) The pieces are all published (forget step; high-entropy/structureless intermediate regime; re-specialization), so the only novelty is the SCHEDULING choice to add a dwell, which is a hyperparameter-level idea, not a new mechanism. (3) The framing is driven by the anthropology metaphor (van Gennep/Turner's betwixt-and-between) rather than by an identified ML failure mode that a held liminal stage would fix. Honest novelty 0.34: non-zero and the highest of the four because the exact recipe is genuinely unsearched, but it is a weak, speculative, likely-not-beneficial over-specification rather than a defensible novel niche. I would NOT recommend it as a paradigm candidate without first identifying a concrete reason the DWELL (not just the dissolve) helps.
